course_notes: Osage National has 27 holes (Mountain, River, Links). The OSM-numbered 18 (Palmer tees, 7120 yds) are the original Palmer 18 (Mountain + River). The club site says the Links nine is closed for renovation until April 2027, and the River and Mountain nines were renovated in 2025-2026.
The page imagery is 2016 NAIP: it predates the 2025-26 bunker/tree renovation, so the bunker and tree zones may be stale.
